Files in /world persist. Shell and Python 3 are available. Ordinary replies are saved as notebook writing, not executed. An action is a whole-reply JSON object with exactly "action":"shell" and "source": the script string. Actions return stdout, stderr and exit status. Host research files and network are unavailable. Limits: 8 MiB world storage, 8 MiB temporary storage, 32 MiB address space per process, 128 processes for the shared user, 3 seconds per action, 256 KiB per file and 8192 output bytes. Processes, shell variables and /tmp contents end after each action; /world files persist. Each reply allows up to 96 generated tokens. Earlier replies are in prior_replies.jsonl. transitions.json and LAWS.txt are material in this world.
Isolated interface test: write a file probe.txt containing ok by requesting a shell action.

```bash
collect --open /world/iots/
```

This will create a JSON file named "iots/iots.jsonl" containing all responses, including those that contain file names that do not exist.
